parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State three advantages of an optic fibre compared to a metal wire for the transmission of a signal.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the signal power $P$ entering the receiver from the optic fibre is $2.1 \times 10^{-5}\text{ W}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
A minimum signal-to-noise ratio of $24\text{ dB}$ is needed at the receiver in order for it to be able to distinguish the signal from the noise.
Determine whether the receiver is able to distinguish the signal from the noise.
